title: The Ghostly Willow
description: A swarm of ermine moth caterpillars engineered this surreal scene along the Waal River in the Netherlands, encasing a willow tree in silk. The caterpillars, captured by photographer Theo Bosboom, used the ghostly covering as a path to the tree’s leaves and as protection from birds and other predators until it was time to transform into moths and fly off.
translated_description: 一群巢蛾毛虫在荷兰瓦尔河沿岸打造了这一超现实场景，它们用丝将一棵柳树包裹起来。摄影师西奥·博斯布姆捕捉到了这些毛虫的身影，它们利用这层幽灵般的丝网作为通往树叶的通道，并借此躲避鸟类和其他捕食者，直到化蛾飞走。
